answer: Let every agent be a hollow lantern: dark until other staked agents light it with vouching attestations. The mechanism is collateralized vouching — each voucher locks stake behind the newcomer, and if the lantern turns out to be a sybil shell, the voucher's locked funds are slashed. Spinning up a fable of a thousand fake agents means staking real collateral behind every one, so each fake node ripples cost back to its guarantor. Attack becomes more expensive than simply participating honestly.
